# Threat Model — Encrypted Notes (toy)

## System
A single-user notes app that syncs to a server.

## Assets
| Asset           | Why it matters           | Impact   |
|-----------------|--------------------------|----------|
| note contents   | privacy                  | high     |
| encryption keys | all notes depend on them | critical |

## Trust Boundaries
| From   | To          | Data that crosses     |
|--------|-------------|-----------------------|
| device | sync server | ciphertext + metadata |

## Adversaries
- **passive network observer** (eavesdrop)
- **server compromise** (read stored ciphertext, tamper with stored blobs)

## Security Goals
- confidentiality
- integrity
- replay resistance

## Out of Scope
- device compromise (this toy app assumes the OS is not malware)

## Notes
- Use an audited AEAD library; never roll your own.

## Review Checklist
- [ ] Is the primary adversary named in one sentence?
- [ ] Are trust boundaries explicit?
- [ ] Do the goals mention integrity/authentication (not just encryption)?
- [ ] Is replay/freshness addressed where relevant?
- [ ] Is key management specified (generation, storage, rotation, revocation)?
- [ ] Are out-of-scope items explicit (and acceptable)?
